en.headline: Labour chief open to classifying heatstroke as occupational disease
en.dek: Commissioner Sam Hui said the government will review this summer’s data on the refined heat-stress warning system before next year’s hot season and remains open to formal occupational-disease status for heatstroke.
body: Commissioner for Labour Sam Hui Chark-shum said on Sunday the authorities are open to classifying heatstroke as an occupational disease, provided there is sufficient medical evidence of a causal link between a worker’s health condition and the specific work environment.

Speaking on a television programme, Hui noted that the refined Heat Stress at Work Warning system, which took effect at the end of August with two additional trigger conditions, will be evaluated using this summer’s data. Any further adjustments will be completed before the next hot season.

He said retrospective modelling showed the new system would have issued a black warning on 8 August and a red warning on 9 August, when the Observatory recorded 36.9 degrees Celsius at its headquarters, the highest temperature since records began in 1884. Under the previous mechanism only an amber warning was triggered on the second of those days.

Hui stressed that employers already have a legal duty under the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance to manage heat-related risks, including heat exhaustion and heatstroke, even though the preventive guidelines themselves are not legislation. He urged employers to conduct risk assessments, provide rest breaks, shade, ventilation and cooling measures, and to reschedule heavy outdoor work away from the hottest hours.

zh.headline: 勞工處長對中暑列職業病持開放態度
zh.dek: 許澤森表示會按今夏數據檢視優化後的工作暑熱警告，明年夏季前決定是否再調節，並稱中暑列職業病須有醫學因果關係支持。
body: 勞工處處長許澤森周日表示，當局對將中暑分類為職業病持開放態度，但職業病須證明工人健康狀況與特定工作環境有醫學上的因果關係。
他在電視節目中指出，8月底起進一步優化的「工作暑熱警告」系統加入兩個新觸發條件，勞工處會根據今年夏季數據評估成效，並於明年夏季前決定是否再調節。
許澤森指，若套用優化後機制，8月8日會發出黑色警告、9日會發出紅色警告；當日天文台總部錄得36.9度，是1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫。舊機制下9日只發出黃色警告。
他強調，即使預防中暑指引並非法例，僱主仍有責任按《職業安全及健康條例》管理高溫工作風險，包括熱衰竭及中暑，否則屬違法。他呼籲僱主做好風險評估，提供休息、遮蔭、通風及降溫措施，並將重體力戶外工作安排在較涼時段。
